changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Gel des versions d'un document archivé (§12.6).
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_version_document_archive BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.ged_version_document_archive()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_version_document_archive ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.version_document
